description: A WinUI 3 app hits an access violation in Microsoft_UI_Windowing_Core while debugging with the XAML Hot Reload in-app toolbar enabled, from https://github.com/microsoft/microsoft-ui-xaml/issues/8806.
prompt:
This only happens under the VS debugger, about ten seconds after opening our second window. The same branch runs if I start without debugging.

```
ExceptionAddress: Microsoft_UI_Windowing_Core!Api::ReunionApi32::GetWindowFeatureImpl+0x20
ExceptionCode: c0000005 (Access violation)
Attempt to read from address 0000000000000030
```
